user.description: Exchange files with an AI chat: export Assist data or YAML configuration, review the returned changes, then apply them. Open HA Landscape in the sidebar; no LLM API connection is required. An additional CSV inventory is available through the integration's entities. Exported CSV files are public at `/local/ha_entitaeten.csv` until you delete them.

delete_csv.description: Deletes the public entity inventory file.
delete_csv.name: Delete CSV file

export_csv.description: Creates a complete CSV inventory of all Home Assistant entities.
export_csv.name: Create CSV export
